title: gui: Flow mode v3 — Feature tab (entrypoint call tree/sequence)
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W3]
Seats: GRAPH-08
Extend crates/gui/src/flow/ with a third sub-tab Feature: pick an entrypoint + depth, render core::feature slice as an ordered call tree/sequence (depth columns or indented tree with call lines + confidence), playable with the existing playback engine (reuse playhead/pulse/step card), click-through to source, honest empty/unknown states. Owner: crates/gui/src/flow/* (feature.rs new). Depends: CORE-5 (feature.rs). Verify: cargo build/clippy/test -p repowalk-gui; feature slice of fixtures/sample entrypoint renders expected order.

EVIDENCE:
Files: crates/gui/src/flow/feature.rs (new: entry picker, ordered step rows, coverage header, 4 tests) + crates/gui/src/flow/mod.rs (FlowTab::Feature, FlowState feature fields, Sequence::Feature/UnknownFeatureEntry, find_call for parent-edge confidence, sub-tab). No other file touched.
Flow mode -> Feature tab: entry picker = one-shot entrypoint chips from index.files[].is_entrypoint (each file maps to its main/first callable) + fuzzy "any symbol" search (core search::search); depth slider 0..=6 (default 3). Steps render in core feature::slice order (entry first, then BFS by depth, ties by call line then symbol id): each row shows the symbol name, a d{depth} badge, and the call-site line (`entry` for d0). Rows are driven by the shared transport (active step = step_alpha wash, click seeks + selects); clicking a step calls app.select(Selection::Symbol(id)) and the currently selected symbol is highlighted (SURFACE_SELECTED + accent spine). Detail panel shows the parent edge's confidence via find_call. Click-through to source via app.open_file_with.
Coverage: reads core metrics::compute().fan_in (no call-graph re-implementation). A callable (SymbolKind Function|Method) is covered when the index records >=1 caller edge to it (a Call edge's callee is a symbol id; an Import edge's callee is a file path, so no false positives), never called otherwise. Header: `N of M callables covered · K never called` plus a collapsible never-called list (click selects), scope toggle slice|repo.
R-20 honesty: muted footnote under the steps states "follows Call edges only · Unresolved edges skipped · name-only / ambiguous hops are not confirmed" (core feature::slice filter); no name-only edge is shown as confirmed. Honest states: no index -> hint; no entry -> "pick a feature entrypoint above"; unknown entry (slice None) -> "unknown entry — <name> is not a symbol in this index"; one-step feature renders one row.
GATES (real, after concurrent graph/render.rs + notes.rs edits settled): cargo fmt -p repowalk-gui -- --check -> exit 0; cargo clippy -p repowalk-gui --all-targets -- -D warnings -> exit 0; cargo test -p repowalk-gui -> 76 passed / 0 failed; flow:: -> 9 passed (4 new: slice_steps_follow_core_order_with_lines_and_depth_badges, coverage_classifies_called_vs_never_called, empty_unknown_and_single_step_states_are_honest, entrypoint_files_resolve_to_their_primary_symbol). No new dependencies.
